$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFQG (AIP France, chart dated 2024-07-11): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

A "fr" object holds the French column of the same chart, copied as printed and never translated: a French note sits at the index of its English twin and is left empty when the twin could not be paired with certainty; the French of the procedures and of the points' purposes is not recorded.

notes: Possible IFR operations.
AD reserved for radio-equipped ACFT.
Simultaneous use of both RWY prohibited.
In case of glider activity: Two glider line-up areas are defined as a rectangle on each end of the unpaved RWY.
South boundaries of these areas are located at 75 m from the paved RWY axis.
They extend over 30 m from RWY THR.
The paved RWY can be used for TKOF and LDG if some ACFT are located in the line-up area or in the gliders vacating area.
TKOF and LDG prohibited if there is an ACFT on grass strip.
Restrictions paved RWY 12/30: prohibited for ACFT whose reference TKOF distance is greater than 1200 m.; mandatory TKOF from RWY ends.

The grass strip can be used: at TKOF if some gliders are located in the vacating area or in line-up area.; at LDG if some gliders are located in the vacating area or in line-up area maintaining the RWY THR crossing at a minimum altitude of 15 m.
As soon as the tow plane declares he's lining up ahead of a glider, paved and unpaved RWY are unusable.
Grass strip 12/30 reserved for authorized ACFT, not available after rain.
TWY A width: 10,00 m.
TWY B width: 10,50 m.
THR 30 strength: 17 F/C/W/T.
Preferred QFU: 301° due to IFR procedure.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
Do not use PAPI if eye-to-wheel height exceeds 3 m.
Hospital overflight prohibited, except SAMU helicopter.
Base leg direct joining from the South is prohibited to ACFT.
Only are allowed medical flights between the airport and the hospital.

Utilisation simultanée des deux pistes interdite.
En cas d'activité planeur : Deux zones d'alignement planeurs sont définies comme un rectangle à chaque extrémité de la piste gazonnée.
Les limites sud de ces zones se situent à 75m de l'axe de la piste revêtue.
Elles s'étendent du seuil de piste sur 30m.
La piste revêtue peut être utilisé pour le DEC et ATT si des aéronefs se situent dans la zone d'alignement ou dans la zone de dégagement des planeurs.
DEC et ATT interdits en cas de présence d'appareil sur la piste en herbe.
Restrictions piste revêtue 12/30 : interdite aux aéronefs dont la distance de référence au décollage est supérieure à 1200 m. décollage obligatoire depuis les extrémités de piste.

La piste non revêtue peut être utilisée : au DEC si des planeurs se trouvent en zone de dégagement ou en zone d'alignement. à l'ATT si des planeurs se trouvent en zone de dégagement ou en zone d'alignement en respectant le franchissement du seuil de piste à une altitude minimum de 15 m.
Dès lors que l'avion remorqueur annonce s'aligner devant un planeur, les pistes revêtue et non revêtue sont inutilisables.
Bande gazonnée 12/30 réservée aux ACFT autorisés, inutilisable après pluie.
